hints.title: Two-Part Invariant
hints.text: A beautiful integer must have an equal count of even and odd digits, and its overall value must be divisible by k.

hints.title: Digit DP Formulation
hints.text: Count beautiful integers up to high and subtract those up to low - 1 using digit dynamic programming.

hints.title: State Parameters
hints.text: Track current index, diff between even and odd count, running modulo k, tight upper bound flag, and started flag.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: d: number of digits in high
complexity.notes: Digit DP state memoized across digit index, parity difference, modulo, and tight flags.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute-force iteration over up to 10^9 numbers times out.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Track modulo arithmetic alongside parity balance in a standard digit dynamic programming state.
